headline: Magoola blames Ugandan ‘mafia’ for Dei BioPharma bad publicity
summary: Dei BioPharma says unnamed international interests blocked a planned US$430 million funding package and ran a smear campaign against its Shs723 billion government investment. The company made the claims from Matugga.
why: Dei BioPharma is a Ugandan pharmaceutical company with state investment, and funding disputes can affect its ability to build out manufacturing and attract investors.
